Chapter 1261: 17: The Great Demon Attacks The Mountain (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1261: Chapter 17: The Great Demon Attacks the Mountain (Seeking Subscription)_2

As for the current situation where the world has undergone a great transformation, and demonic qi permeates, making the cultivation environment poor, even possessing rune inheritance, it’s quite difficult to perceive the rules of the Grand Dao… that’s true for other strong individuals.

Lin Yuan, possessing Against-Heaven’s Understanding, as long as the rules of the Grand Dao exist, can smoothly cultivate rune inheritance.

And even if the rules of the Grand Dao in this Fang Yuan World were completely suppressed by demonic qi, Lin Yuan could still perceive the rules of the Grand Dao in other dimensions; the so-called demonic qi is only limited to this Fang Yuan World.

The actual impact on Lin Yuan is very limited.

…

“However, with the physical potential of this Fang Yuan World, what kind of Physical Body Divine Ability will eventually be nurtured?”

Lin Yuan found himself anticipating.

The physical body of the first source world did not have high potential; the concentration of the ancestral bloodline was far from being considered royalty.

The reason it could grow to such a height was entirely due to Lin Yuan’s own cultivation.

But this Fang Yuan World? Lin Yuan’s descended physical body can be fully regarded as a direct descendant of the thirteenth-caliber temporal life.

In the Six Ancient Countries, this is undoubtedly the strongest bloodline, even surpassing the core royal family.

The current core royal families of the Six Ancient Countries cannot truly be considered direct bloodlines of the ancestors; they merely have a relatively high concentration of ancestral bloodline.

True direct bloodlines of the ancestors are very rare; reaching the level of an ancestor, the limits for giving birth to genuine direct descendant bloodlines are vast.

It’s easy for an ancestor to have descendants, but direct descendants? That’s quite difficult.

…

Lin Yuan entered the Qingyun Institute as a disciple in the second year.

The physical body had completely shifted onto the Martial Arts Evolution Road, and then began to cultivate the fundamental power deep within the bloodline, nurturing new Physical Body Divine Skills.

“At least over ten thousand years to nurture.”

Lin Yuan was certain in his heart, following the rules of previous nurturing of Physical Body Divine Skills.

The longer it takes to nurture the Physical Body Divine Skills, the greater its potential and power, such as the previous Physical Body Divine Skill ‘Fierce Sun Opening the World,’ which took thousands of years to nurture.

And for this Physical Body Divine Skill, nurturing time is directly over ten thousand years?

Lin Yuan could not help but feel anticipation.

“What exactly happened to this Fang Yuan World? What is this great transformation of the heavens and earth? And why did the physical bodies of living beings become so terrifying after this great change?” Lin Yuan pondered over the strange perplexity.

Enhancing the physical potential is not difficult for Lin Yuan, but to simultaneously increase the physical potential of an infinite number of beings in a source world, even for a thirteenth-caliber temporal life, is as hard as ascending to heaven.

Moreover, the increase in physical potential before and after the great transformation of heaven and earth is substantial.

“Thinking about these things now is too far-fetched.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts collected, his current strength not yet restored, even if the truth of this Fang Yuan World were known, it would have little significance.

Once he returns to his peak, many secrets will be clear even without asking.

[Name: Chen Tong (Lin Yuan)]

[Identity: Keeper of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Bonded Talent: Heaven-defying Comprehension]

[Divine Power: Blood Resurrection]

….

[Divine Power: Fierce Sun Opening the World]

[Divine Power: In Nurturing….]

[Current State: Consciousness Descent]

[Remaining Stay Time: None]

…..

“Unrestricted stay, I have plenty of time.”

Lin Yuan understood in his heart.

Once stepping into the twelfth layer, consciousness descent can traverse, as long as the vessel does not completely die, he can essentially stay indefinitely.

…..

Lin Yuan entered the Qingyun Institute as a disciple in the fourth year.

The whole Qingyun Sacred Mountain started to faintly tremble.

The Qingyun Sacred Mountain is the residence of the Qingyun Saint Sect, and through the sacrificial refinement of strong individuals from past generations of the Holy Sect, it is no longer merely a mountain but an incredibly powerful Great Saint Weapon.

“The Great Demons are starting to attack the Mountain.”

Numerous disciples of the Qingyun Saint Sect felt a tremor in their hearts, as demons are divided into four levels: Demon Spirit, Great Demon, Source Demon, and Demon God.

There’s no need to consider Demon Gods; apart from appearing during the initial chaos transformation, they haven’t surfaced since.

As for Source Demons? Extremely rare, and even if they show up, they are attracted by the several eternal sectarian forces.

Currently, the greatest threat to the Qingyun Saint Sect is the Great Demons.

Even Great Demons lack independent thoughts, wandering between heaven and earth like zombies.

If any passing Great Demon happens to discover the anomaly of the Qingyun Saint Sect, it will attempt an attack, known as the Great Demon Assaulting the Mountain.

The Qingyun Sacred Mountain is perpetually shrouded in a breath-concealing formation; normal ‘demons’ discover no anomaly, but Great Demons are different. If too close, they might sense something amiss.

Of course, if after a period of attacking, no further anomalies are found, the emotionless Great Demon will leave on its own.

This means having withstood the Great Demon Assault.

During a Great Demon Assault, the Qingyun Saint Sect must not counterattack actively.

Otherwise, it will attract more Great Demons, and even with its strength, the Qingyun Saint Sect would be exhausted to death by one Great Demon after another.

“Great Demon?”

Lin Yuan stood in front of the Qingyun Institute, looking afar at the gigantic figure outside Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

That figure, surrounded by endless demonic qi, gathered a large amount of demonic qi, constantly hurling at the Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The shaking of Qingyun Sacred Mountain was due to the collisions of these terrifying streams of demonic qi.

“This Great Demon, each attack reaches a peak Chaos Realm and can swallow endless demonic qi, indeed very difficult to handle.”

Lin Yuan closely observed, more importantly, the Great Demon is nearly immortal, meaning even if a strong figure at the level of the Free and Wandering Three Realms took action, at best they could suppress the Great Demon, but to kill it thoroughly?

Not possible.

In truth, this applies not only to Great Demons but to any demon.

Even if its demonic body is obliterated, ‘demons’ will coalesce again at another location.

The only way to completely annihilate a demon is to become demonic, then devour the ‘demon.’

Since the great transformation of heaven and earth, the appearance of one demonized person after another stems not only from the drastic increase in power from becoming demonic but because only those who have become demonic can entirely eliminate ‘demons.’

Roaring flames.

The Qingyun Sacred Mountain sways.

In the view of the outside Great Demon, the Qingyun Mountain is just a massive ordinary mountain, and after attacking for a while with no gain, the Great Demon shakes its head and strides away.

“The Great Demon has left?”

“We’ve held it off.”

Many disciples of the Qingyun Saint Sect felt a slight relief internally.

Every time a Great Demon assaults the mountain, the Qingyun Saint Sect faces the danger of annihilation.

Any disciple, upon seeing that towering Great Demon figure, feels a certain indescribable oppressive sensation swelling in their hearts.

“Seems truly lacking in intelligence.”

Seeing the Great Demon leave, Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

“If nothing unexpected happens, the Qingyun Saint Sect won’t withstand many more Great Demon assaults.”

Lin Yuan pondered internally, though not yet restored to full strength, his vision remained keen, discerning the ‘weakness’ in Qingyun Sacred Mountain exposed when resisting the Great Demon’s attacks.

Eldest Senior Brother Li Qing choosing to become demonic in an attempt to save the Qingyun Saint Sect wasn’t without merit; as the senior disciple of the sect, Li Qing should be well aware of the sect’s current plight.

“The source of this great transformation appeared in the world’s center, the place where demonic qi erupted, temporarily held back by those few eternal sect powers. The Great Demons now threatening Qingyun Saint Sect are nothing compared to the real danger at the center of the world.”

For a world like Fang Yuan to be plunged into such a desperate state, it surely wasn’t a mere mortal danger.

Torrential energies clash, but outside, to the Great Demon, the Qingyun Mountain appears just a simple giant mountain. Attacking for a while without any further gain, the zombie-like Great Demon withdraws.

This marks the successful defense against this Great Demon Assault.

During the Great Demon Assault, the Qingyun Saint Sect must refrain from counterattacking.

Otherwise, it will attract more Great Demons, and at that point, no matter how powerful the Qingyun Saint Sect becomes, they will be exhausted by one Great Demon after another.

“Great Demon?”

Lin Yuan stood in front of the Qingyun Institute, gazing at the colossal figure looming outside Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

This figure was wrapped in an infinite, endless demonic qi, and at this moment, a great deal of demonic qi was coalescing, furiously pounding against the Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The tremor of the Qingyun Sacred Mountain was due to these terrifying collisions of demonic qi.

“This Great Demon’s every attack reaches the peak of the Chaos Realm, and it can swallow endless demonic qi; indeed, it’s challenging to deal with.”

Lin Yuan observed carefully, realizing that even if a strong cultivator at the highest three realms made a move, they would at best only be able to suppress this Great Demon. As for killing it completely?

It’s not possible.

In fact, all demons are like this.

Even if their demonic bodies are destroyed, ‘demons’ usually wander back together at some other location.

The only way to annihilate a demon since the great change in the world is to enter the demonic state and absorb the ‘demon.’

The Qingyun Sacred Mountain trembled.

From the vantage point of the Great Demon outside, the Qingyun Mountain only seemed an ordinary giant mountain, and after attacking for a while without discovering more, the Great Demon sways and strides away.

“The Great Demon left?”

Lin Yuan remained thoughtful as the others in Qingyun Saint Sect expressed their relief, knowing each Great Demon assault posed an existential threat to them.

Upon seeing the towering figure of the Great Demon departing, all disciples felt a certain inexorable pressure lifting from their hearts.

“It seems to lack any real intelligence.”

Lin Yuan saw the Great Demon leave, contemplating in silence, knowing though his full strength wasn’t restored, his insight remained, allowing him to detect the ‘weakness’ the Qingyun Sacred Mountain faced while repelling the Great Demon assault.

Senior Brother Li Qing decided to become a demon to try to save the Qingyun Saint Sect, not entirely without reason; as the senior disciple, Li Qing would know the current tribulations of the Qingyun Saint Sect.

The source of the heaven and earth great transformation was rumored to be at the world’s center, where demonic qi erupted, currently held back by those several eternal sect powers. In comparison, the Great Demons threatening Qingyun Saint Sect are insignificant against the central world’s power.

Capable of plunging this entire Fang Yuan World into such a bleak scenario, it surely is no ordinary matter.

With these thoughts, Lin Yuan returned to the Qingyun Institute to continue comprehending the rune inheritance, intending to integrate it with the development of the Constant Sand Particle World.

“So far, twelve particle worlds have been created.”

Maintaining these particle worlds doesn’t require the slightest effort from me; relying on rune inheritance as a foundation.

It’s just….

“””
